name: Modern SEO - Module 4 Client Acquisition and Pricing
body:
> Course · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Module 4 (5 lessons, about 21 minutes), named "Client Acquisition Fundamentals" in the course sidebar, turns from ranking clients to running the agency: getting clients and pricing the work so every client is profitable. Lesson 1 names four acquisition channels (Facebook Ads, local networking, content marketing, referrals) and covers the paid one; Lessons 2 and 3 cover the free ones; Lesson 4 is pricing; Lesson 5 explains when the course's methods stop being enough. The thread through all of it: show value before you sell.

# Lessons
- [Modern SEO - M4L1 Facebook Ads Overview and Unlock](lib:brain-modern-seo-m4l1-facebook-ads-overview-and-unlock): call-based ads funnel (claimed 97 clients in six months), locked until you post a Core 30 gap analysis; $20 to $30 a day minimum; no guarantees.
- [Modern SEO - M4L2 Local Business Networking Strategies](lib:brain-modern-seo-m4l2-local-business-networking-strategies): free rank map plus a few immediate fixes as the offer; no pitch, no follow-up pressure.
- [Modern SEO - M4L3 YouTube Content Marketing](lib:brain-modern-seo-m4l3-youtube-content-marketing): audience avatar, binge sessions, interconnected educational content; months to years.
- [Modern SEO - M4L4 Pricing Framework with Examples](lib:brain-modern-seo-m4l4-pricing-framework-with-examples): scope-based pricing, every step costed, 50 to 70% gross margin, month one setup plus about five articles, nine a month after.
- [Modern SEO - M4L5 What Happens When You Outgrow Modern SEO](lib:brain-modern-seo-m4l5-what-happens-when-you-outgrow-modern-seo): three signs a client needs more (plateau, very competitive market, complex technical issues); mostly a Pro pitch.

# Combined framework
1. Prove you can do the work: a full Core 30 gap analysis.
2. Pick channels by budget and timeline (ads fastest and paid; networking and content free but slower).
3. Lead with a free, specific diagnosis (rank map plus fixes, or public audits as content).
4. Let prospects come to you; nurture with email.
5. Scope and price: cost every step, add 50 to 70% margin, no setup fee.
6. Present scope and value first, with good, better, best options.
7. Deliver with Modules 1 to 3; watch for the outgrow signs and price technical work separately.

# How the lessons connect
- The ads unlock is the [Modern SEO - M3L2 Core 30 Gap Analysis](lib:brain-modern-seo-m3l2-core-30-gap-analysis) process.
- The free rank map is the M1L4 "North Star" used as a sales tool; its fixes are three-step items.
- Public audit content is the M1L2 live breakdown turned into marketing.
- Pricing setup = Module 2 audits; per-article costs = Module 3 content. The complex project and sign 3 reuse the M3L1 lobby test.

# How this applies at TAG
- Most of this module is for TAG as an agency; acquisition and pricing are Scott's decisions. Kim can bring him the free rank map approach and the cost list as options.
- For [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub): update older posts with internal links to each new article, link blog posts into a path, and run the outgrow check on rank maps.
- Alphalete fits the "complex project" pattern; scope technical fixes separately from content.

# Caveats and open questions
- Referrals are named as a channel but never taught.
- Lesson 4 promises examples but shows no prices; the written lesson text on the course page may have them.
- Plateau number: 5 to 10% (L5 audio) vs 10 to 15% (L5 slide, and the Core 30 trigger). Technical threshold: 450, 500 or 500+ URLs; none firm.
- Paid or locked items needing approval: Facebook ad spend, Chamber membership, LeadSnap, PBN links (confirm with Scott), the Pro group.
